items.value:
spec:
  containers:
  - name: advertest-gpu-worker
    image: asia-southeast1-docker.pkg.dev/ai20k-build/advertest/gce-worker:gpu-dispatch-v7
    env:
    - name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
      value: ai20k-build
    - name: GCP_PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION
      value: projects/ai20k-build/subscriptions/advertest-gce-worker
    - name: MODEL_DEVICE
      value: cuda:0
    - name: MODEL_HALF_PRECISION
      value: 'true'
    - name: GPU_IDLE_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS
      value: '900'
    - name: OBJECT_STORAGE_BACKEND
      value: s3
    - name: OBJECT_STORAGE_BUCKET
      value: advertest-prod-artifacts
    - name: OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT_URL
      value: https://storage.googleapis.com
    - name: OBJECT_STORAGE_REGION
      value: auto
  restartPolicy: Always
